meta_title: PFG Services North West | Plumber Preston
meta_description: PFG Services North West is a trusted plumber in Preston. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and maintenance. Call 07800 667241 for fast local service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipes, boiler breakdowns, and leaks won't wait. We're in Preston within the hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Preston and Surrounding Areas
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle all your plumbing needs with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We diagnose and repair most faults on the first visit, with parts carried on the van.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating reliable and efficient. Annual servicing cuts breakdowns and extends boiler life; urgent repairs available 24/7.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Modern, energy-efficient systems tailored to your home. We handle the full install, commission, and provide a long-term warranty.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New installations, tap replacements, and suite upgrades. We fit, seal, and test everything to the highest standard.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Slow drains and blockages cleared using proven techniques. We identify the cause and prevent future problems.

services.title: Radiator & Hot Water Issues
services.desc: Bleeding, balancing, and replacing radiators to restore warmth to cold rooms. Fast diagnosis of temperature and pressure faults.

about_pullquote: I started PFG because I got tired of plumbers who didn't show up or overcharged people.
about_para_1: PFG Services North West has been serving Preston and the surrounding area for over 15 years. We built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing things properly, and charging a fair price. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local team, but we've never lost sight of what matters: treating your home with the same care we'd give our own.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we get the job done right first time, and we're honest about what needs doing and what doesn't. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or hide costs. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler upgrade, you'll get the same straightforward, professional approach from PFG.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About PFG Services

reviews.text: Burst pipe on a Sunday night — nightmare. Called PFG and they were round within 45 minutes. Sorted it in under an hour, charged a fair price, and didn't make a mess. Top bloke. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our boiler serviced before winter. The engineer was knowledgeable, thorough, and explained everything clearly. It's reassuring to have someone you can trust with your heating. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret W.

reviews.text: New bathroom suite fitted by PFG. They turned up on time, worked cleanly, and finished when they said they would. No stress, no drama, just good honest work. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: James M.
